items.raw_snippet:
Andrew here. Amid a slew of headlines about A.I. agents escaping their sandboxes, Nvidia is releasing a software platform that aims to put firm guardrails around agentic software. It says the system would have prevented the recent hacking of Hugging Face by OpenAI’s models.

In related news, we have a scoop on Instinct, the hot A.I. agent start-up. This 14-person company has raised $1 billion at a $10 billion valuation from some of Silicon Valley’s biggest venture capital firms. More below. [...] ## Liability questions lie ahead

Researchers have announced a steady drumbeat of discoveries of artificial intelligence models behaving badly, pushing the topic of A.I. safety to the fore.

That raises a big question for investors in potential blockbuster I.P.O.s by Anthropic and OpenAI: How much liability could they be on the hook for?

The latest: [...] Newsletter
